anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential performance bottlenecks.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect trading operations, which is critical for platform reliability.
